name: Apply built-in film LUTs without file uploads
description: Verifies selecting any film stock automatically supplies and applies its built-in creative 3D LUT.
steps: Open Video Lab and import a supported Rec.709 video
Select Kodak Portra 400, then Kodak Gold 200 and Fujifilm Velvia 100F
Compare the preview after each stock selection
Confirm no camera LUT upload control is present
expected: Each stock applies its own built-in 3D colour transform automatically, and the interface has no manual LUT upload or remove control.

name: Browse and render film stocks with stock texture
description: Verifies the stock browser, playback, film texture processing and rendered video workflow remain available.
steps: Open Video Lab and import a supported Rec.709 clip
Search for Vision3 500T and select it
Play the clip and compare it with Portra 400
expected: The selected stock visibly changes the grade, grain and highlight treatment, playback works, and a WebM render is produced.

name: Show input colour-space guidance on mobile
description: Verifies the simplified source guidance is readable on mobile and does not imply unsupported camera transforms.
steps: Select a film stock and open Adjust
expected: The guidance states that built-in stock LUTs expect Rec.709 and that Log/HDR needs prior normalisation; no file upload control is shown.
